original.question_en: List the TDocs postponed to the next meeting at RAN1#120 (tracking open items).
original.cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting {meetingNumber: 'RAN1#120'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc {status: 'postponed'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type ORDER BY t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

proposed_meaning: Source-register postponed status at the exact canonical RAN1#120 meeting; source design explicitly defines postponed as next-meeting deferral. This does not assert actual subsequent attendance, final report consistency, or present-day unresolvedness.
requested_roles: TDoc identity only; title/type are optional witnesses.
